blocks.text: ORLANDO, Fla. — Isaiah Joe had 21 points and Daniss Jenkins added 15 to spur the Detroit Pistons past the Orlando Magic 104-86 in an NBA Cup game on Tuesday night. With leading scorer Cade Cunningham out with a knee injury, Detroit also got 13 points from Ron Holland and improved to 2-1 in NBA Cup group play. The Pistons handed Orlando its first loss of the in-season tournament, preventing the Magic from clinching East Group A.
